        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json
inp=[[0,0,0,0,0,8,8,0,0],[0,0,0,0,0,8,0,8,0],[0,0,0,0,0,8,8,0,0]]
def transform(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    # find rows containing 8
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(x==8 for x in g[i])]
    r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows)
    cols=[j for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==8]
    c0,c1=min(cols),max(cols)
    shape=[[1 if g[i][j]==8 else 0 for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    n=2
    out=[]
    for row in shape:
        out.append([(8 if x else 0) for rowc in [row]*n for x in rowc])
    return out
o=transform(inp)
for r in o: print(r)
print(json.dumps(o))
